journey.name: TL-03 Completing a task marks it and survives a refresh
journey.description:
Covers FR-03. The completed state has to reach the source, not just the checkbox: TaskApi has no "set completed" operation, so TaskRepository.setCompleted reads the task's current fields and re-sends them with the flag flipped (WALKTHROUGH.md section 5). A refresh is what proves the round trip happened.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the "Renew domain registration" row has an unchecked checkbox
Tap the checkbox with the content description "Mark complete" on the "Renew domain registration" row
Verify that the "Renew domain registration" row now has a checked checkbox
Verify that the "Renew domain registration" title is struck through
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is still in the first position in the list
